method: Read original OOXML worksheet cells with unzip and xml-js, independently of the Go dataset reader and goal Engine. Stored numeric lexemes, not recalculated formulas. These cells supplement, not replace, education-citywide-reference.json.
limits: Publisher total and adjacent cells are source context, not a certified logical-table boundary, student definition, district mapping or goal approval. Other worksheet cells, including AK41, remain outside this selected context.
